description: A global setup that throws a plain object (T9.15): it is no Error, so Jest raises a new one whose message holds the object as pretty-format prints it, three levels deep (`Object {` on the first line, then one property to a line), and the CLI prints that error's stack. No test file runs and the exit code is 1. The black-box run captures the exit code and every stderr line that is not a stack frame.
